====Usage notes====
Complex future forms such as {{m|pl|[[będzie]] potrafić/potrafił(a/o)}} are proscribed. Instead only the simple future {{m|pl|potrafi}} or {{m|pl|[[będzie]] [[umieć]]/umiał(a/o)}} are prescribed.

The active adjectival participle {{m|pl|potrafiący}} is also proscribed, instead either a subordinate clause with {{m|pl|który}} or {{m|pl|umiejący}} are prescribed.
